g.text: canvas 2048 x 2048 px unit 1600 px ground point [1088, 1840]
Grid: 0.1 bird height. Faces right. Paint each part on its own layer, at canvas size.
Coloured dot and name: a bone's joint (its pivot). Line: the bone.
Dashed ring: paint both parts past it, so a turn opens no gap.
Diamond: where a loose part hangs from (follow root).
Shapes, named in black: the path rig's parts. A guide, not a rule.
